# Native recording-engine fixture

Captured on Android 14 with the pinned TalkBack companion, SDK 36, JDK 17, and
Gradle 8.14.3. These are actual focus commands and independent durable journals.
The journals are stored separately to avoid escaped copies in capture.json;
tests hydrate the loggingTts envelope before validation. No speech text or
identities were synthesized or normalized. The engine generated silent PCM.
